title: GoodWe ESA GW5K-ETA-G20 (5 kW three-phase power module)

items.question: What backup rating does GW5K-ETA-G20 have?
items.answer: The AC side backup port of the GW5K-ETA-G20 has a rated apparent power of 5 kVA.
items.answer_de: Die AC-seitige Notstromschnittstelle des GW5K-ETA-G20 hat eine Nennscheinleistung von 5 kVA.

items.question: How many MPPTs does GW5K-ETA-G20 have?
items.question_de: Wie viele MPPTs hat der GW5K-ETA-G20?

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)

items.question: Which battery modules stack with this power module?
items.answer: The manual lists the battery modules GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20, and states that battery modules of different models can be mixed. For stacking, the manual gives these limits: GW5.1-BAT-D-G20 and GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 up to 3 batteries, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20 and GW8.3-BAT-D-G21 up to 2 batteries, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 up to 3 batteries, GW9.0-BAT-D-G20 up to 2 batteries. When GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 and GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 are mixed and stacked, each system group supports up to 3 batteries. For floor installation, up to 4 batteries can be stacked away from the wall and up to 6 batteries against the wall.
items.question_de: Welche Batteriemodule gehören zu diesem Leistungsmodul?
items.answer_de: Das Handbuch nennt die Batteriemodule GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 und GW9.0-BAT-D-G20 und gibt an, dass Batteriemodule verschiedener Modelle gemischt werden können. Für die Stapelung nennt das Handbuch folgende Grenzen: GW5.1-BAT-D-G20 und GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 maximal 3 Batterien, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20 und GW8.3-BAT-D-G21 maximal 2 Batterien, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 maximal 3 Batterien, GW9.0-BAT-D-G20 maximal 2 Batterien. Bei gemischter Stapelung von GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 und GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 unterstützt jede Systemgruppe maximal 3 Batterien. Bei der Bodenmontage können maximal 4 Batterien von der Wand entfernt und maximal 6 Batterien an der Wand gestapelt werden.
